start: Owner signed in online, a member sent a question and placed a shop order

steps.action: Tap the bell
user_sees: Lines for what waits, newest first, a 'New' tag on unseen ones
When nothing waits: 'Nothing is waiting for you. New messages and requests from your members will show here.'
must_not: Alerts of another gym or branch
A line missing that the desk can see

steps.action: Tap a line
user_sees: The right page opens (the question, the order)
The line leaves the waiting list once the thing is done, with 'Done by <name>' in History
must_not: The line gone just because it was opened, while the thing is not done
The bell count not going down

steps.action: Tap the cross on a line ('Remove from your list: <line>')
user_sees: 'Removed from your list.' with 'Undo'
must_not: The underlying question or order deleted
Removed for every other person too, when it is 'your list'

start: Owner on Settings (or the offer card 'Get alerts on this device')

steps.action: Tap 'Turn on alerts on this device' and allow notifications in the browser
user_sees: 'Alerts are on for this device.'
Card with 'Send a test alert'
must_not: On for the person's other devices too
A browser prompt that returns on every page

steps.action: Tap 'Send a test alert' and close the admin app
user_sees: 'We are sending a test alert to this device. It can take up to a minute. …'
A notice pops up; back in the app: 'Sent. Did a notice pop up? It showed on this device at <time>.'
must_not: The test shown on other people's devices
A second test allowed at once (then 'You just sent a test. You can send another in <n> seconds.')

steps.action: A member places a shop order while the app is closed
user_sees: A notice on this device; a tap opens the order
must_not: No notice because the tab was hidden
Two notices for one order

steps.action: Block notifications in the browser, then tap turn on
user_sees: 'Alerts are blocked in this browser. Allow notifications for this site in the browser settings, then come back here.'
must_not: 'Alerts are on' while blocked

steps.action: Open the card in Safari on an iPhone, not from the Home Screen
user_sees: 'On an iPhone or iPad, first add the admin app to your Home Screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen). Open it from there and turn alerts on.'
must_not: A turn-on button that does nothing

steps.action: Send a test with the phone on Do not disturb
user_sees: 'We sent it, but this device has not shown it yet.' and 'Things to look at on this device:' with the three checks
must_not: 'Sent' with a time when nothing was shown

start: Owner with alerts on, a done line and a removed line in the bell

steps.action: Open 'History' in the bell
user_sees: 'The last 7 days: what was done, opened or removed. Tap a line to open it.'
Tags 'Done', 'Opened', 'Removed', 'Removed · Not done yet'
must_not: Lines older than 7 days
A removed line that cannot be opened any more

steps.action: Tap 'Undo' on a removed line
user_sees: It is back in the waiting list
must_not: Back as 'New' with a fresh notice

steps.action: Tap 'Turn off on this device', then turn on again
user_sees: 'Alerts are off for this device.' then on again
must_not: Notices still coming while off
The other devices of the person turned off

steps.action: In alert timing choose daily at a time, save; later choose instant
user_sees: 'Your gym gets everything else together, every day at <time>.'
The always-at-once list is still at once
must_not: A shop order or complaint held for the daily summary
The time saved in another time zone

start: Owner gets a notice on the phone's lock screen

steps.action: Read the notice without unlocking
user_sees: A short line that something needs the gym
must_not: A member's mobile number or the full text of a complaint on the lock screen

steps.action: Sign out of the admin app on this device
user_sees: No more notices on this device
must_not: Notices of the gym still arriving on a signed-out or removed person's phone
